title: coord.py serve reads a request body before it checks the token, so a client with no valid token holds a thread
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G5 (ST-rk5ks4pf): do_POST reads Content-Length bytes (up to 64 KB) before authenticate, with a 30 s per-read timeout and unbounded daemon threads, so a client with a wrong token that sends a short body and dribbles bytes holds a thread and a descriptor for hours. A request with an unknown token gets 401 from its headers alone, before any body is read.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
keys=os.path.join(D,'ops');os.mkdir(keys)
for n in ('alice','bob'):
    open(os.path.join(keys,n),'w').write(n[0]*40);open(os.path.join(D,n+'.key'),'w').write(n[0]*40)
srv=s.Popen([sys.executable,T,'serve','--bind','0','--keys',keys],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=E)
url=srv.stdout.readline().split()[-1].strip().rstrip('/')
hp=url.split('//')[1];host,port=hp.rsplit(':',1);port=int(port)
try:
    so=socket.create_connection((host,port),timeout=10)
    so.sendall(b'POST /v1/run HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\nAuthorization: Bearer wrong\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: 65536\r\n\r\n[')
    so.settimeout(3)
    try:
        got=so.recv(200)
    except socket.timeout:
        got=b''
    print('reply within 3 s:',got[:40])
finally:
    srv.terminate();srv.wait(10)
sys.exit(0 if b' 401' in got else 1)
